title: Sky Block
description: Configure the skybox and atmospheric effects for the environment.

skyurl.description: Equirectangular sky texture URL. When set, the texture replaces the procedural atmosphere.

rayleigh.description: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for atmospheric haze

sunpositionx.description: X component of sun direction vector

sunpositiony.description: Y component of sun direction vector

sunpositionz.description: Z component of sun direction vector

turbidity.description: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored by the runtime sky renderer. Atmospheric turbidity (haziness)

miedirectionalg.description: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored by the runtime sky renderer. Mie scattering directional coefficient

miecoefficient.description: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored by the runtime sky renderer. Mie scattering coefficient
